New alert: order-worker falling behind during Diwali Dhamaka Sale. Service: order-worker, severity: SEV1.
Symptoms: Orders are taking much longer than usual to move from 'placed' to 'confirmed' since the Diwali Dhamaka Sale kicked off a few minutes ago; the order pipeline looks like it's falling behind the incoming volume.
Error: order-processing consumer group falling behind on the order-events topic

Evidence (only these incidents may be cited):
Incident INC-006 (order-worker, SEV1, 2026-06-03T10:02:18Z):
Symptoms: During the Summer Splash Sale flash promotion, order-events consumer lag climbed past 48k messages; order confirmations delayed up to 20 minutes.
Root cause: Sale traffic pushed the produce rate to ~4x baseline; the order-processing consumer group (3 replicas) could not keep pace with partition throughput.
Resolver: Rahul Mehta

Incident INC-020 (order-worker, SEV1, 2026-08-15T21:07:52Z):
Symptoms: During the Independence Day Mega Sale, order-events consumer lag began climbing again within minutes of the flash sale start.
Root cause: Sale traffic again exceeded consumer throughput capacity, same as INC-006, but this time the team pre-scaled ahead of the event per the INC-006 postmortem action item -- lag still spiked briefly due to a delayed autoscaler trigger.
Resolver: Rahul Mehta

Ranked fixes (use the top one as first_actions[0]):
  1. scale_consumer_replicas (score=+0.430, worked=2, partial=0, failed=0, recent_failures=0)
  2. increase_topic_partition_count_live (score=-0.109, worked=0, partial=0, failed=1, recent_failures=1)
RISKY fixes -- ledger failures exceed successes (do NOT recommend these in any first_action, not even as a last resort): increase_topic_partition_count_live
Recurrence: This is occurrence #3 of this pattern, recurring roughly every 73.5 days.
Team expert: Rahul Mehta (Resolved 2 incidents matching this pattern with a working fix.)
